title: Ridgeline Pro Credit Correction Standard — Re-Rated Late Fee and the Amount of a Late Fee Correction
content:
**Clause.** On a Ridgeline Pro Credit revolving account, the re-rated late fee is the tier's late fee, so a late fee posted at the tier's late fee needs no correction. The late fee correction is the posted late fee less the re-rated late fee, never below zero, to the cent.

## Inputs

| Input | Source |
|---|---|
| Posted late fee | The amount of the most recent late fee posted on the account |
| Tier's late fee | The late fee of the account's tier, per the Ridgeline Pro Credit fee schedule (39.00 on the Pro Revolving Charge, 49.00 on the Pro Revolving Charge Plus) |

## Worked cases (hypothetical)

| Tier | Posted late fee | Re-rated late fee | Late fee correction |
|---|---|---|---|
| Pro Revolving Charge Plus | 49.00 | 49.00 | 0.00 — no correction |
| Pro Revolving Charge | 49.00 | 39.00 | 10.00 |
| Pro Revolving Charge | 39.00 | 39.00 | 0.00 — no correction |

## Basis Q&A

**Which late fee is re-rated?** The most recent late fee posted on the account.

**Can the correction be negative?** No; it is never below zero, so a posted late fee at or below its re-rated amount carries no correction.
